# app-declarations-in-sync

Fails if `plugins/apps-core/server/internal/apps.generated.ts` drifts from the
apps the browser registers (`Apps.App`): each app's whole `AppRef` and whether
it launches as a tab or a surface mode. The server serves every app's web-app
manifest and icon, and paints the first frame's per-app theme, from that file,
so a stale copy serves an app that no longer exists or misses a new one. Fix by
running `./equin build` and committing the regenerated manifest.
